title: Report: Dianna Russini, Mike Vrabel "coordinated" on how to respond to New York Post report

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Dianna Russini, Mike Vrabel "coordinated" on how to respond to New York Post report
sources.description: Despite being the biggest story in the NFL for 10 days and counting, the photos of Patriots coach Mike Vrabel with former Athletic reporter Dianna Russini have been ignored by most mainstream media outlets.
